definitions.explanation: A removable or hinged piece that covers an opening or container.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}の{蓋|ふた}をしてください。
examples.english: Please put the lid on the pot.

examples.japanese: ペットボトルの{蓋|ふた}が{開|あ}かない。
examples.english: I can't open the bottle cap.

examples.japanese: {蓋|ふた}を{開|あ}けたら{良|よ}い{匂|にお}いがした。
examples.english: When I opened the lid, there was a nice smell.

examples.japanese: {弁当|べんとう}{箱|ばこ}の{蓋|ふた}がなかなか{閉|し}まらない。
examples.english: The lid of the lunch box won't close properly.

examples.japanese: {炊飯器|すいはんき}の{蓋|ふた}を{開|あ}けると、{炊|た}きたてのご{飯|はん}のいい{匂|にお}いが{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: When I opened the lid of the rice cooker, the nice smell of freshly cooked rice filled the air.

notes:
{蓋|ふた} is used for lids and covers of all kinds of containers.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {蓋|ふた}をする (to put on a lid)
- {蓋|ふた}を{開|あ}ける (to open a lid)
- {蓋|ふた}を{閉|し}める (to close a lid)
- {蓋|ふた}を{取|と}る (to remove a lid)

NOTE: The kanji {蓋|ふた} is often written in hiragana as ふた.

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- キャップ (cap - for bottles)
- カバー (cover)
